X.Org first-party advisory https://lists.x.org/archives/xorg/2025-June/062055.html: a client may pass no cursors while the server assumes at least one, causing an out-of-bounds read while creating an animated cursor.

At parent-of-fix 3bdb541e042124e418d5ae4eac6bd47e2ffd2cc0, ProcRenderCreateAnimCursor uses REQUEST_AT_LEAST_SIZE(xRenderCreateAnimCursorReq), computes ncursor=(req_len - bytes_to_int32(sizeof(req)))>>1 (zero when the request is header-only), allocates with xallocarray(ncursor, ...), skips the population loop, and calls AnimCursorCreate; AnimCursorCreate then reads cursors[0]->foreRed/foreGreen/foreBlue/backRed/backGreen/backBlue with no ncursor check (animcur.c lines 325-331).
Fix commit 0885e0b26225c90534642fe911632ec0779eebee quotes a valgrind invalid 8-byte read in AnimCursorCreate after a size-0 reallocarray in ProcRenderCreateAnimCursor.
